dishes.name: Leipziger Allerlei
dishes.desc: Mixed spring vegetables with morels, crayfish and butter sauce. A Leipzig classic that varies from simple vegetable medleys to the refined original.

dishes.name: Leipziger Lerche
dishes.desc: Shortcrust tartlet with almond filling, topped with a cherry and two crossed pastry strips. It replaced the real songbirds once baked into it.

dishes.name: Leipziger Räbchen
dishes.desc: Prunes stuffed with marzipan, coated in batter, fried and rolled in cinnamon sugar. A warm Leipzig sweet, eaten around the Christmas market and in cafés.

dishes.name: Leipziger Eierschecke
dishes.desc: Three-layer cake of yeast dough, quark and egg custard. Saxon-wide, but baked in Leipzig's traditional cafés and bakeries.
